verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਛਪ ਧਰਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਕਰੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੁਤ ਨ ਲਗਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise kachhap dhar dhiaan saavadhaan karai taise maat pitaa preet sut na lagaaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as a she tortoise bears its young ones in sand and takes care of them till they are sufficiently capable of looking after themselves, such love and concern for parents cannot be the characteristic of a child.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕਰਿ ਕੂੰਜ ਪਰਪਕ ਕਰੈ ਤੈਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਸੁਤ ਪੈ ਨ ਬਨਿ ਆਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise simaran kar koo(n)j parapak karai taiso simaran sut pai na ban aaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as a crane teaches its young ones to fly and make them adept by flying many miles, a child cannot do for his parents.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਗਊ ਬਛਰਾ ਕਉ ਦੁਗਧ ਪੀਆਇ ਪੋਖੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਬਛਰਾ ਨ ਗਊ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise guoo bachharaa kau dhugadh peeaai pokhai taise bachharaa na guoo preet hit laaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as a cow feeds her young one with her milk and brings him up, the young one cannot reciprocate with same feelings the love and affection for the cow.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਤੈਸੇ ਕੈਸੇ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਠਹਿਰਾਵਈ ॥੧੦੨॥
verses.translit_en: taise giaan dhiaan simaran gursikh prat taise kaise sikh gur sevaa Thahiraaviee ||102||

en.bdb: As a True Guru blesses a Sikh and expresses his love by making him well versed in divine knowledge, contemplation and meditation on Lord's name, how can a devoted Sikh rise to the same level of dedication and devotion in the service of Guru? (102)
